description: Issue ONE scoped, expiring capability credential. use it rather than `verify_agent_credential` for agent credential specifically; an object with 26 fields including credential_id, credential_token. $0.05 USDC.

issued_for.description: Who the credential was issued to, for the record.
issued_for.title: Issued For

max_uses.description: How many uses the credential is granted (1..100000).
max_uses.title: Max Uses

policy_ref.description: The policy the credential is issued under. Its SHA-256 is carried in the credential.
policy_ref.title: Policy Ref

scopes.description: The scopes to grant. Every scope must be in the documented vocabulary; an unknown scope is a 400 with the vocabulary in the body. A wildcard is refused.
scopes.title: Scopes

subject.description: Who the credential is for, e.g. 'did:agent:abc'.
subject.title: Subject

ttl_seconds.description: How long the credential is valid, in seconds (1..2592000).
ttl_seconds.title: Ttl Seconds

name: issue_agent_credential

error.description: The machine-readable error code, when the operation failed.

signature.description: The Ed25519 signature over the evidence core, base64-encoded.

title: Issue Agent Credential
